snippet.title: Northmen | Launch Trailer | Out Now on Steam for 99 Cents
snippet.description:
Get Northmen on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5481810/Northmen/

Out now. Price: 99 cents. Yes, really.

The year is 793. You have a handful of spears, a cold shore and absolutely no plan beyond "go west, take things". Northmen is a pixel-art love letter to Nordic culture in the Viking Age. The whole world is your map, so sail off and take Japan if the mood takes you. It is fun, engrossing and relaxing, and no single wrong move ends your saga.

RAID: march war bands on monasteries and towns, then sack, conquer or burn them. Shield walls, wedges, rams and sieges.
BUILD: grow a longhouse into a jarl's hall with barracks, forges, markets and trade routes by road and sea.
SAIL: longships, knarrs and drakkars to carry your armies across the sea.
CONQUER: a real map of the world in the year 800, 38 historical peoples, holy places of nine faiths and 24 wonders to find.
RAGNARÖK: when the age ends, the gods ride out. Endgame mode on the field of Vígríðr.

Single-player. 21 languages. Windows.

#Northmen #VikingGame #StrategyGame
